title: Agent minutes across native and cross-platform mobile stacks
summary: Błażej Kustra compares six mobile stacks using the same notes-app specification, one Claude Opus agent at a time, five follow-up changes, and 32 hidden QA checks. Swift finishes the iOS portion close to React Native, while the separate Kotlin app increases total native delivery time; an iOS team can measure build waits, accessibility, and device behavior separately instead of treating agent minutes as the whole quality result.
takeaway: Benchmark the same bounded specification and follow-up changes with hidden QA checks; separate iOS build waits, Android reuse, accessibility failures, and real-device behavior from total agent time.
